prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. A NEW natural editorial photograph, horizontal 3:2, for a Brazilian parenting Instagram carousel. A fictional 12-year-old boy with light brown skin, straight dark brown hair with a gentle side fringe, a cobalt blue T-shirt is sitting at a light wooden kitchen table explaining a route to his fictional mother. Mother about 37, light brown skin, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, ivory linen shirt. Boy looks toward her with an engaged expressive face and his index finger points at the corner of a hand-drawn map on the table. Mother listens, with a curious interested expression, not laughing or playing stupid. Camera at a high three-quarter angle across the table, BOTH faces clearly visible in the upper half, paper visible large in the lower center. The paper must show the supplied reference map as a physical drawing: yellow house at one end, L-shaped blue route turning beside a round green tree, school with red roof and a blue gate at the other end. The reference image is ONLY a prop insert for the PAPER, not the whole photo. Preserve that exact map structure and only one corner. Daylight in a cozy ordinary Brazilian home, subtle yellow and blue touches, natural skin texture and anatomically correct hands. Not a luxury home or classroom. No computers in this photo. No writing, address, school name, labels, text overlay, brands or watermarks. Fictional people, not known students or staff. Warm believable interaction, not stock-photo poses.

Use case: illustration-story. Create an editorial drawing of an entirely fictional neighborhood route for a parent-and-child exercise, landscape 3:2. Straight overhead view of one off-white drawing sheet filling the frame, no desk or hands. Simple expressive colored pencil drawing appropriate for a 12-year-old, not toddler scribbles. Warm yellow house with blue door at lower left (center around 20% x, 72% y). A pale gray street leads from this house horizontally right to a corner at 72% x,72% y, then turns upward toward a small school building at 72% x,23% y. School: white building with red roof, simple clock circle, blue windows and visible blue entrance gate facing the street. One large leafy rounded tree just to the RIGHT of the corner, used as a landmark. A bold continuous royal blue pencil line with two small arrowheads follows the L-shaped route exactly from house door to corner to school gate. Clearly ONE corner and TWO buildings, no other streets, no extra buildings, no cars. Plenty of off-white negative space above the house and below the school for labels to be applied later. Beautiful real paper texture, organic graphite outlines, sparing green and yellow shading. No writing, letters, words, numbers, labels, school name, address, legends or watermark. Must look like an inviting hand-drawn plan on paper, not a digital app or navigation screenshot.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. NEW close-up editorial photo, landscape 3:2. Image 1 is the paper map reference and must remain the SAME fictional L-shaped route, yellow house lower left, round tree at right-hand corner, red-roof school with blue gate above. Image 2 is the mother/son hands, clothes and wood table reference only. Camera directly overhead, only two hands and the physical sheet on the table, no faces. The 12-year-old boy's smaller right hand enters from the left, his index finger touching the road corner beside the tree. The mother's adult hand enters from the top right, her index finger touching the SCHOOL GATE. This makes two different indicated places immediately clear. Both index fingers clearly touch the respective objects; do not point at empty paper. Full map visible. A blue pencil beside the sheet. Natural skin, clean anatomically correct hands with five fingers, warm daylight, sharp drawn map. No additions to map, no extra turns, no text, numbers, labels, addresses, logos or watermarks. Same home as image 2 but a totally different crop.

His hand holds a blue colored pencil with tip at the L-shaped corner as he finishes the arrow there. The entire paper is visible on the warm wooden table, rotated slightly clockwise in the frame. A straight blue pencil, green and yellow colored pencils at the far edge. This is a DIFFERENT photo and action from the pointing scene, a tangible plan being finished. Photo realistic hand and materials, no computer, no screen, no added words, labels, watermark, school name or address. The hand must not hide the house, tree or school. Keep the simple map intact, no imaginary extra buildings or routes.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. NEW landscape 3:2 editorial photograph, for the final slide of a parenting carousel. Image 1 is ONLY identity reference: keep the exact same fictional 12-year-old boy, straight dark brown side fringe, light brown skin and cobalt-blue T-shirt.
